Checkbox.Name: set_skip_cutscenes
Checkbox.Tooltip: Every cutscene can be skipped with the skip button, including the opening, the staff credits and the title-screen demos that normally can't be. Cutscenes still start: items and story progress are given inside them.

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_story_scenes
Checkbox.Tooltip:
Since 0.8.0 this also skips the area intros (it was a setting of its own before).
The cutscenes that come with quest progress don't play; you get their item straight away: - Temple of Time: the door opening, Ganondorf, pulling the Master Sword, and Rauru's talk in the Chamber of Sages (his Light Medallion check is given at once); - adult Temple of Time: Sheik's first talk, the sages' talks, Zelda's reveal and the Light Arrows; - after a boss: each sage's awakening and medallion, and the Deku Tree / Darunia / Ruto handing over the Spiritual Stones; - leaving Kokiri Forest: Saria's goodbye on the bridge (the Fairy Ocarina is given at once); - the Kokiri Sword chest: Link's sword swing and Navi's tip after it (the chest opens like any other); - the rest of each post-boss chain (the Deku Tree's death, Darunia, Ruto, the Deku Sprout, the lake refilling...), Sheik/Mido/Ruto/Nabooru before the adult temples, and Ganon's Castle's first visit, trial barriers and tower barrier (not yet tested in-game); - Kakariko Graveyard: the Royal Family's Tomb opening to Zelda's Lullaby, and the Sun's Song stone inside (its lesson and scene; its check is given at once; not yet tested in-game). Other song lessons, boss intros and the ending still play (Make All Cutscenes Skippable covers those). Tested in-game so far: Rauru's Light Medallion after the Master Sword, the Great Deku Tree after Gohma (his check is given) and Saria's Fairy Ocarina on the bridge. Known to still play: leaving the Temple of Time as adult.
Area intros: first-arrival camera pans don't play: Kakariko, Graveyard, Hyrule Castle, Lake Hylia, Gerudo Valley/Fortress, Zora's River/Fountain, Ganon's Castle, and the Fire Temple / Bottom of the Well / Spirit Temple entrances (tested). Those areas count as visited, so their maps work without the intro's area-name banner, and Kaepora still waits at Lake Hylia for his ride. Also skipped, keeping the quest step they start (not yet tested): inside the Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Death Mountain Trail from Kakariko, Goron City, Death Mountain Crater, Zora's Domain, Lon Lon Ranch, Castle Town, Sacred Forest Meadow, Desert Colossus, Ice Cavern, Shadow Temple, Gerudo Training Ground, the Water Temple, inside Ganon's Castle and the Temple of Time (first entry, and first step out as adult).

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_npc_dialogs
Checkbox.Tooltip: Characters' story talks that only tell the story don't play again and again: once a quest has moved on, they skip to their short line (Saria after the Deku Tree, for example). Talks that give an item, teach a song or move a quest on still play. A temporary setting while it is being tested; it will become part of Skip Cutscenes.

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_kaepora
Checkbox.Tooltip: Kaepora Gaebora doesn't stop you to talk when you leave Kokiri Forest, in the Lost Woods after Saria's Song, in Hyrule Field (also on the way to Lake Hylia), in front of Hyrule Castle or at Zora's River. The quest menu and the amiibo menu item he unlocks are available anyway, the field music plays, and Castle Town works as if he had talked to you. His optional rides at Lake Hylia and Death Mountain are unchanged.

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_opening
Checkbox.Tooltip: A new game doesn't play the opening movie (the narrated prologue and the Great Deku Tree's dream). The game still waits for Kokiri Forest to load. Whatever this is set to, every seed starts outside in front of the Kokiri Shop, without Navi's flight, Navi waking Link or Saria at the door.

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_deku_talk
Checkbox.Text: Skip the Great Deku Tree's Talk
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Great Deku Tree's speech when you first reach him doesn't play: his mouth is open and you can walk straight in. With Mido still blocking (Kokiri Forest not Open), this happens when Mido steps aside after seeing your sword and shield.

Checkbox.Name: set_quick_chests
Checkbox.Tooltip: Big chests open without the camera move and Link's opening animation: the lid opens, Link holds the item up and its message shows. The fanfare starts at once. Small chests keep their own short opening. The Kokiri Sword chest's sword scene is Skip Cutscenes.

Checkbox.Name: set_bag_bombs_no_bracelet
Checkbox.Tooltip: Bombs from the bag can be pulled out and thrown as soon as you have a Bomb Bag. In the remake they normally need the Goron Bracelet, which the original always gave you first. Bomb Flowers still need the bracelet. Off: the logic expects the Goron Bracelet before bombs.

Checkbox.Name: set_dodongo_bag_bombs
Checkbox.Tooltip: A bomb from your Bomb Bag breaks the boulder in front of Dodongo's Cavern when it explodes, like any bombable rock (no cutscene), so you don't need the Goron Bracelet to open it. The bomb flower still plays its cutscene. Off: only the bomb flower next to it works, which needs the bracelet.

Checkbox.Name: set_gs_any_time
Checkbox.Text: Gold Skulltulas Day and Night, Any Age
Checkbox.Tooltip: Night-only Gold Skulltulas are there in the daytime too, and the overworld Gold Skulltulas that only appear for adult Link (Kakariko, Death Mountain Trail, Zora's River and others) are there for child Link too, at the same spot; it's the same Skulltula, so it counts once. Not copied: the ones tied to another object (Lake Hylia, Zora's Domain) and Gerudo's Fortress (child can't go there). The logic doesn't count on this: it still expects night or adult Link for them.

Checkbox.Name: set_skip_ganon_trials
Checkbox.Tooltip: The six trials inside Ganon's Castle count as done from the start: the barriers are gone and the way up the tower is open. The trial rooms and their chests are still there. The logic then only needs the rainbow bridge, the Bow and the Light Arrows to beat Ganon (the trial rooms' own checks still expect what the trials need).

Checkbox.Name: set_saria_song_ocarina
Checkbox.Text: Saria's Song With Just an Ocarina
Checkbox.Tooltip: Saria teaches her song in Sacred Forest Meadow as soon as you own an ocarina (either one); you don't need to meet Zelda first. Works with any Kokiri Forest setting.

Checkbox.Name: set_anju_one_cucco
Checkbox.Tooltip: Return a single cucco to Anju's pen in Kakariko to finish her minigame and get the reward.

Checkbox.Name: set_big_poe_one
Checkbox.Text: Poe shop requires only 1 Big Poe
Checkbox.Tooltip: Sell a single Big Poe to the ghost shop in the adult Market to get his reward (normally five, 500 points).
